note: How an envelope is said against what the player's household spends to live: in words, never a figure (owner, Nov 11 rule 101). Each row is the largest number of days of the household's living costs the envelope may equal and still be said that way; the first row that holds is the one said. Every cutoff is TUNABLE and registered as SG-STORY-arc-variant-weights beside the variants' own weights.
checkedAgainst: Dinner money is under a few days of a household's costs; a month of bills is the rent and the groceries together; the cutoffs are people's own round spans, checked by reading the words aloud for a small, a middling and a large envelope in the walk.
